sources.title: ALCOSAN Clean Water Plan, Section 4: Hydrologic and Hydraulic Characterization
sources.model_scenario: Existing-condition typical-year hydrologic and hydraulic model simulation
sources.model_period: A refined calendar-year 2003 rainfall dataset calibrated to produce annual statistics equivalent to a 60-year historical precipitation record; not observed overflow data from a single calendar year.
sources.license: Public agency report; retain attribution to ALCOSAN.

sources.publisher: Pittsburgh Water and Sewer Authority via Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center
sources.title: Combined Sewershed
sources.field: CSO_SHED (parcel records store joined values in combined_sewershed_ids)
sources.vintage: July 2018 resource; checked-in project source manifest verified 2026-09-26
sources.geography: Mapped combined sewershed polygons in the City of Pittsburgh.

steps: Read each combined_sewershed_ids value as a slash-delimited list of outfall tokens.
Match each token to one unique ALCOSAN table outfall_id exactly, case-insensitively.
Honor only exact report_aliases explicitly stated in a CWP table or footnote (for example C-03A-OF).

If and only if no exact ID exists, append the single documented terminal marker "-OF" and require one unique table ID match. This accounts for the PWSA base label (for example A-42) versus report outfall marker (A-42-OF).
A slash-composite is a direct match only when every token resolves uniquely, including an explicitly printed report alias; never fuzzy match, infer topology, use distance, or use nearest outfall.
join_method.unmatched_handling: Return disclosed matched-system regional typical-year fallback and list unmatched sewershed labels; do not assign a nearby outfall.

coverage_snapshot.parcel_source: original repository data/processed/parcels.json inspected 2026-09-27; 22,233 parcel records; parcel_context.jsonl contains id/transit/geometry fields only and is not the sewershed join source.
coverage_snapshot.coverage_note: Runtime coverage measured on active data/processed/parcels.json (build_overflow_inputs): direct matched context for 14,948 of 22,233 parcels; 7,285 receive the disclosed regional fallback. The 86 complete-match labels are unique labels, not a count of parcels. Recalculate when parcel data or the model registry changes.

normalization_boundary: Only slash tokenization, case-insensitive exact ID / explicit report-alias match, or adding a terminal -OF marker when that exact candidate exists are allowed. No punctuation stripping, number changes, fuzzy aliases, or spatial proximity joins.

normalization_examples.rule: append exact terminal -OF; unique table ID
slash split; first token gets terminal -OF addition; second is exact ID
exact report_aliases value stated in Table 4-4 footnote

row_provenance.volume_semantics: Each row is ALCOSAN modeled annual CSO overflow volume at the named outfall. Parcel-level direct values sum unique matched outfall rows; they are not parcel wastewater flow or added-flow contribution.

spot_checks_manually_verified_against_pd.check: High-volume row; confirms comma-formatted 1,085-hour cell and 777 MG/year volume are separate columns.
Explicit modeled zero row; kept as zero rather than missing.
PWSA municipal outfall row; confirms frequency, duration, and volume column assignment.
Wrapped A1_MCD0002-3(1) row is present in the municipal table; it was restored to the registry so its modeled volume is available to exact-label matches.

extraction.extractor: Poppler pdftotext -raw; standard-library parser in pipeline/overflow_context.py
extraction.runtime_policy: Parcel API/runtime reads only checked-in data/models/alcosan_overflows.json; no PDF, network, or parser dependency is required at runtime.
extraction.identity_policy: The checked-in row identity, table, note-reference, and verified-alias fields are the stable parsing keys. On explicit refresh, every registered row is located in the pinned source tables and annual frequency, duration, volume, model status, and physical/printed page are re-extracted. Missing or duplicate row matches fail closed.
extraction.integrity_policy: Refresh verifies the pinned source PDF SHA-256 and refuses a different document until its source vintage and metadata are reviewed.

verified_refresh.corrected_page_reference: C-04-02-OF2 is printed on PDF page 36 / report section page 4-36.
